title: Function Composition and Inverse Functions
seo_title: Composition and Inverse Functions Worksheet: f(g(x)), Finding Inverses (Algebra 2) | 100 Questions
standard_text: Find inverse functions. Solve an equation of the form f(x) = c for a simple function f that has an inverse and write an expression for the inverse.
meta_desc: Free Algebra 2 worksheet on function operations, composition f(g(x)), finding inverses, verifying inverses and the horizontal line test. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: f(g(x)): work from the inside out. To find an inverse, swap x and y and solve.
key_sub: f and g are inverses when f(g(x)) = x.
body_html:
How it works

Functions can be added, subtracted, multiplied and divided like expressions: (f + g)(x) = f(x) + g(x).

A composition f(g(x)) puts the output of g into f. Work from the inside out. Usually f(g(x)) ≠ g(f(x)).

An inverse f−1 undoes f. To find it, swap x and y and solve for y. Two functions are inverses when f(g(x)) = x and g(f(x)) = x. A function has an inverse function only if it passes the horizontal line test.

Example

f(x) = x² + 1 and g(x) = 2x − 3. Find f(g(2)).

g(2) = 1

f(1) = 2

Answer: 2

Example

Find the inverse of f(x) = 4x + 7.

x = 4y + 7

y = (x − 7)/4

Answer: f−1(x) = (x − 7)/4

Common mistakes

  • Multiplying f(x) · g(x) when the question asks for f(g(x)).
  • Evaluating the outer function first. Start with the inside.
  • Writing f−1(x) as 1/f(x). The −1 is not an exponent here.
  • Undoing the steps in the same order. Undo them in reverse order.

faq.a: Replace every x in f with the whole expression g(x), then simplify.

faq.q: How do you find the inverse of a function?
faq.a: Write y = f(x), swap x and y, and solve for y. The result is the inverse function.

faq.q: How can you tell if two functions are inverses?
faq.a: Compose them both ways. If f(g(x)) = x and g(f(x)) = x, they are inverses.

faq.q: What is the horizontal line test?
faq.a: If any horizontal line crosses a graph more than once, the function is not one-to-one, so its inverse is not a function.

items.q: A tutor charges $15 per hour plus a $20 booking fee, so C(h) = 15h + 20. Owen paid $65. Use the inverse to find how many hours he booked.
items.e: The inverse is h = (C − 20) ÷ 15. (65 − 20) ÷ 15 = 3 hours.
